title: Google contextual advertising in Spain: order setup

facts.fact: The page states that Spain has a population of nearly 50 million.
facts.quote: Spain has a population of nearly 50 million, a high rate of online shopping, and an audience accustomed to searching for products and services online.

facts.fact: The vendor cites unspecified 'various estimates' saying the average Google Ads cost per click in Spain is roughly half that of the U.S.
facts.quote: according to various estimates, the average CPC is roughly half that of the U.S.

facts.fact: The page says that for most European niches the cost per click is around a couple of euros, and in less competitive niches it drops to €1.
facts.quote: For most European niches, the cost per click hovers around a couple of euros, and in less competitive niches, it drops to €1.

facts.fact: The page says that in less competitive niches the cost per click drops to €1.
facts.quote: in less competitive niches, it drops to €1.

facts.fact: The page says the official Rebajas sales in January and July reshape retail demand in Spain.
facts.quote: The Rebajas (official sales) in January and July reshape retail demand.

facts.fact: The vendor claims that contextual advertising in Spain can produce results within the first week of launch, rather than after six months of SEO.
facts.quote: Not after six months of SEO, but within the first week of launch.

facts.fact: The page names four regional languages used in Spain besides standard Spanish: Catalan, Valencian, Galician and Basque.
facts.quote: in Catalonia (which includes Barcelona)—Catalan; in the Valencian Community—Valencian; in the northwest—Galician; and in the Basque Country—Basque.
